Name: Armoni, Son of Saul
Summary: Armoni, son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, was handed over with his brother Mephibosheth to the Gibeonites in atonement for Saul's slaughter of Gibeon, and was hanged at the beginning of barley harvest.
KeyStory: Armoni, Rizpah's son, was hanged for a bloodguilt he did not commit.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Rizpah, Daughter of Aiah; Mephibosheth, Son of Saul
LifeLesson: The sins of kings are sometimes paid by sons who never sat on a throne.
